arguments.summary: A spear-phishing campaign attributed to APT-41 (Double Dragon) successfully compromised a high-criticality finance workstation (WS-FIN-042) via a malicious email attachment. The initial payload, 'chrome_helper.exe', executed through Outlook-launched PowerShell, deployed a ShadowPad variant using process hollowing and established C2 communication over HTTPS to a known-bad IP and domain. The attacker attempted lateral movement via SMB and Kerberos TGT requests. The threat was detected via IDS signature and EDR process monitoring, but containment actions were not executed due to incorrect targeting.

timeline.description: User jsmith opened Outlook, initiating session on WS-FIN-042.
Malicious PowerShell executed from Outlook process with encoded command.
rundll32.exe loaded unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory, establishing C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23:443.
IDS triggered 'ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity' alert on outbound traffic from WS-FIN-042.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042 to DC at 10.0.3.10, indicating credential access attempt.
SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server WS-FIN-050, indicating lateral movement.
Incident formally escalated and assigned to SOC team for post-incident reporting and improvement.

arguments.summary: A critical APT intrusion was detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to APT-41 (Double Dragon). The attack began with a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell download from Outlook, leading to the execution of a ShadowPad variant via rundll32.exe. The malware established C2 communication over HTTPS to a known malicious IP and performed lateral movement via SMB. Immediate containment actions included blocking the C2 IP at the firewall. No data exfiltration was confirmed, but privilege escalation and lateral movement were observed.

Encoded PowerShell command executed from Outlook process (T1566.001).
rundll32.exe loaded malicious beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
IDS triggered on Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 traffic to 198.51.100.23:443 (T1071.001).
Failed Kerberos TGT request indicating potential credential access attempt (T1558.001).
Lateral movement detected via SMB to file server 10.0.5.50 (T1021.002).
EDR confirmed malicious process tree and network connections.
Sandbox analysis attributed malware to APT-41, identifying ShadowPad variant and associated IOCs.
Firewall rule deployed to block C2 IP 198.51.100.23 outbound (FW-RULE-0007).
Incident formally escalated and reported.
